title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness - Pre Vocational Studies - Agriculture in Stock Exchange
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A highly organized financial market where shares, stocks, and bonds of large agricultural companies are bought and sold is known as the ________.
questions.explain: A stock exchange is a specialized market where securities (such as shares of publicly traded agricultural companies) are bought and sold by investors.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following groups of people are actively involved in stock exchange transactions?
questions.explain: The stock exchange primarily involves investors looking to buy shares, investors willing to sell shares, and licensed intermediaries called stockbrokers or agents.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In the stock exchange market, professionals who act as intermediaries to buy and sell shares on behalf of agricultural companies and investors are called ________.
questions.explain: Farmers' agents or stockbrokers are licensed professionals who execute the buying and selling of securities on behalf of investors and agricultural firms in the stock market.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: One of the major importance of the stock exchange in the agricultural sector is that it ________.
options: Distributes free land to peasant farmers
Encourages heavy investment and capital generation for agricultural firms
Eliminates the need for pest control on farms
Regulates the amount of rainfall per season
questions.explain: The stock exchange allows agro-allied companies to raise massive capital by selling shares to the public, thus encouraging long-term investment in commercial agriculture.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: How does the stock exchange help to stabilize farm produce production for large agro-allied companies?
options: By encouraging contract farming to guarantee steady supply
By physically guarding the farm premises against thieves
By increasing the temperature of greenhouses
By importing cheap food from other continents
questions.explain: Through stock market financing, agricultural companies often engage in contract farming, guaranteeing smallholder farmers a ready market for their produce and ensuring a stable raw material supply.
